To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
5-nitrodinol-2,3 dione derivatives were found to be cytotoxic against human cancer cell lines.

a new series of 1-morpholine or piperidinomethy-5-nitroidole-2,2-dione-3- thiosemicarba- zones were synthesized and evaluated for their primary cytotoxicity in vitro against 60 human tumou- r cell lines.
the new compounds were active on a non-small lung cell line, HOP-62, and on leukaemic cells, HL-60(TB) and MOLT-4.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and evaluation of the cytotoxic activity of new 5-NITROINDOLE-2,3-DIONE-3-THIOSEMICARBAZONES.
the design of new 5-substituted-1H-indol-2,3dione-3-thioksemicarbazide derivatives as potential anticancer agents.
the development of new 5-NIADT derivatives as potential anticancer agents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the new series of compounds 4a-m are active against a broad spectrum of human tumour cell types and are worthy of further investigation as potential antitumor agents.
the compounds 4a-m were more potent than 3a-k, and that the most active compound was 1-morpholine methyl-5-nitronidole-2, 3-dione- 3-N-(chloro-phenyl)-thiosemicabazone.
the new compounds are more active than the standard drug, doxorubicin, in the 60 cell line screen.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
compounds 3b,3c,3f,3k,4a, 1c,4f and 1l are the most promising compounds and should be evaluated for their antitumour properties in vivo.
5-nitronitroindole 2,3-diones and their thiosemicarbaones are a new class of compounds that are worthy of further exploration for their cytotoxic properties.
the compounds with morpholine or with piperidine and a phenyl ring on the thiosemicarboxamide side chain are the most active.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 3-thiosemcarbazone derivatives of 5-ni-tro-1Hindole-2-3-dione have significant in vitro cytotoxic activity against a number of tumour cell lines.
the 1-morpholoninomethyl-3-thio-semicarbazone derivative of 5-ni-troindole- 2,3-dion (4l) was the most active compound in the panel of human tumour cell.
the compounds of the present series are active against human tumour cell cultures and may have a potential use in the treatment of human cancer.
